facts.raw_span: A man in his 40s presented with a new pigmented lesion on his left second toenail
The lesion first appeared 12 months before presentation and was progressively growing
The lesion was asymptomatic
He was otherwise well and denied any fevers or weight loss
dark brown longitudinal pigment band covering the full length of the toenail of the left second digit with corresponding nail thickening over the pigmented band
The pigment was the same width throughout the band and extended to the proximal nail fold
No other nail or skin lesions were found at the time of examination
Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium
No melanocytic lesions observed
Immunostaining negative for S100 and CD34
Intracorneal hemorrhage and adjacent verrucous hyperkeratosis present
Villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia

concepts.why: The presence of bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix, absence of melanocytic lesions, and negative immunostaining for S100 and CD34 support this diagnosis.

The clinical presentation of a dark brown longitudinal pigment band with corresponding nail thickening and the histopathologic findings of villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate are consistent with this diagnosis.

aliases: Nail unit melanocytoma, benign melanocytic tumor
concepts.why: Although the histopathologic examination did not reveal melanocytic lesions, the clinical presentation of a pigmented lesion could still suggest a melanocytoma, but this is less likely given the negative histopathologic findings.
It explains the finding of intracorneal hemorrhage.

rationales.F05: Pigmented band is more typical of onychomatricoma or onychocytic matricoma

rationales.F09: Absence of melanocytic lesions rules out nail unit melanocytoma
rationales.F10: Negative immunostaining for S100 and CD34 rules out melanocytic lesions
rationales.F11: Intracorneal hemorrhage is more typical of subungual hematoma
rationales.F12: Villous fibroepithelial projections are characteristic of onychomatricoma
